sources.snippet: OLMo-1B is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find OLMo-1B on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of OLMo-1B install, users can directly use OLMo-1B installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial.
